# Libertify

> > Libertify transforms documents into interactive AI-powered videos for education, HR, and business communications.

Libertify is an AI document-to-video platform that converts PDFs and static content into engaging video experiences. The platform serves universities, businesses, and content creators with automated video generation technology, while also providing comprehensive university program guides and industry research analysis.

## Key Topics

- AI document-to-video conversion
- Video generation platform
- University program guides
- MBA program admissions
- International student admissions
- HR policy videos
- PDF to video conversion
- Interactive educational content
- Career outcomes analysis
- AI-powered media transformation
- Business school rankings
- AACSB accreditation
- Student mobility programs
- Tech trends analysis
- Enterprise AI adoption

## Platform & Product

- [How to Convert PDF to Video](https://www.libertify.com/how-to-convert-pdf-to-video): Tutorial on converting PDFs to interactive videos using AI-powered tools
- [HR Policy Explainer Videos Employees Actually Watch](https://www.libertify.com/hr-policy-explainer-videos): Create engaging HR policy videos to boost employee compliance & engagement
